g.text: ELE-P1-002 I/O LIST, WIRE NUMBERS, CABLES
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 prototype · 1,000 lb/week, 5 blends (13-blend ready)

svg.text: I/O LIST · P1-225 WAGO PFC200 · 35 points
SR-P1 safety relay healthy (e-stops, hopper lid, screw guard)
P1-301 cover closed and valve shut
B10 low level, Soliphant FTM20 (spare position)
B11 low level, Soliphant FTM20 (spare position)
B12 low level, Soliphant FTM20 (spare position)
B01 agitator relay KA-01 (no flow aid at launch)
B02 agitator relay KA-02 (no flow aid at launch)
B03 agitator relay KA-03 (flow aid fitted)
B04 agitator relay KA-04 (no flow aid at launch)
B05 agitator relay KA-05 (no flow aid at launch)
B06 agitator relay KA-06 (flow aid fitted)
B07 agitator relay KA-07 (flow aid fitted)
B08 agitator relay KA-08 (no flow aid at launch)
B09 agitator relay KA-09 (flow aid fitted)
B10 agitator relay KA-10 (no flow aid at launch)
B11 agitator relay KA-11 (no flow aid at launch)
B12 agitator relay KA-12 (no flow aid at launch)
RS-485 1 pair + drain, Belden 3105A, daisy chain
1. Wire number = PLC-slot-channel; both ends ferruled and labelled with the same number.
2. Field device terminal = cable number + core number (e.g. W-305/3).
3. 24 V DC from PS-608, 0 V bonded to PE at one point per panel.
4. Analog cables shielded, shield grounded at the panel end only.
5. E-stops are hard-wired dual channel to SR-607; PLC sees SRxxx_OK status only.
